label: Page Skeleton
description: Turns anonymous browser geometry into an editable skeleton-loading still or looping shimmer/pulse video.

captureSnippet.label: Browser capture snippet
captureSnippet.description: Copy this exact JavaScript into the browser console. It copies anonymous visible-page geometry as JSON for Page capture.

capture.label: Page capture
capture.description: Anonymous geometry from the page-skeleton browser snippet. See packages/docs/web-page-skeleton/README.md for the capture workflow.

outputFormat.label: Output
outputFormat.description: PNG keeps the editable still; MP4 animates the same rectangles as a looping loading skeleton.

motion.mode.label: Mode
motion.mode.description: Shimmer scans a bright band across the page; pulse breathes all content together.

motion.direction.label: Direction
motion.direction.description: Canvas direction used by the shimmer scan.

motion.bandWidth.label: Band width
motion.bandWidth.description: Width of the shimmer band as a fraction of the canvas axis.

motion.minOpacity.label: Resting opacity
motion.minOpacity.description: Lowest skeleton opacity between shimmer passes or pulse peaks.

motion.label: Motion
motion.description: Looping loading motion used by Animated MP4 output. Geometry and source count stay unchanged.

appearance.bg.label: Background
appearance.bg.description: Canvas color behind the captured page geometry.

appearance.imageFill.label: Image fill
appearance.imageFill.description: Image, video, avatar, and control fill.

appearance.radiusMode.label: Radius mode
appearance.radiusMode.description: Use captured browser radii, square corners, or one uniform canvas-pixel radius.

appearance.uniformRadiusPx.label: Uniform radius
appearance.uniformRadiusPx.description: Canvas-pixel radius used by uniform mode.

appearance.label: Appearance
appearance.description: Page, per-kind skeleton colors, and corner treatment.

behavior.maxRects.label: Max rects
behavior.maxRects.description: Maximum retained capture rectangles and independently placed skeleton sources.

behavior.scaleMode.label: Scale
behavior.scaleMode.description: fit letterboxes, fill crops, stretch scales each axis independently.

behavior.containerMode.label: Containers
behavior.containerMode.description: Keep large painted wrappers or prune wrappers containing several descendants.

behavior.pureRects.label: Pure DSL rects
behavior.pureRects.description: Emit exact frame bounds with no placement insets. Easier for custom cell-local masks, at the cost of a larger m0 program.

behavior.label: Behavior
behavior.description: Capture filtering, scaling, and containing-block behavior.

overrides.label: Rect overrides
overrides.description: Array of {i, hide?, fill?, shape?: "rect"|"rounded"|"pill"|"circle", radiusPx?}. Indices refer to capture.rects[].

debug.label: Debug geometry
debug.description: Run the geometry contract and include capture filtering/drop counts in the document label.

debugIndices.label: Show rect indices
debugIndices.description: Programmatic diagnostic that overlays retained capture indices. Prefer Make canvas selection and the Structure panel for interactive editing.
